class.name: IfcFilter
class.brief_description: A filter is an apparatus used to remove particulate or gaseous matter from fluids and gases. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcFilter defines the occurrence of any filter; common information about filter types is handled by IfcFilterType .
